cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

mechanism: Copy a cake-server's tasting gesture without recognizing its limited purpose, then answer the older lunch-quality question instead of each new accusation about missing birthday cake.
confusable: Not ordinary changing the subject: A must answer the same earlier safe inquiry with sincere useful food details while hiding the copied misunderstanding.
comparison: Food hosting and a missing cake slice rather than driving damage.
seedUse: Retains soup/lunch review as safe earlier answer; introduces copied tasting knife mistaken for permission to eat cake.
